recipe_version.title: Greek Shrimp Saganaki with Tomato, Feta, and Crusty Bread
recipe_version.description: Shrimp baked in a skillet of crushed tomatoes simmered with olive oil, onion, garlic, red pepper flakes, and oregano, crowned with crumbled feta until it softens, finished with parsley and lemon, and served with crusty bread for the sauce.

ingredients.name: large shrimp
ingredients.display_name: large shrimp (26 to 30 per lb), peeled and deveined

ingredients.name: crusty bread
ingredients.display_name: crusty bread loaf (about 1 lb) whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, and salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Chop the onion, slice the garlic, crumble the feta, chop the parsley, cut the lemon into wedges, and slice the bread. Pat the shrimp dry.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 425 F; it heats while the sauce cooks. Heat the oil in the 12-inch oven-safe skillet over medium, about 1 minute, and cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and pepper flakes for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, oregano, and salt, and simmer until thick, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Nestle the shrimp into the sauce in one layer and scatter the feta over. Bake until the shrimp are pink and opaque and the feta is soft and lightly browned at the edges, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Scatter with parsley and serve from the skillet with lemon wedges and the bread.
